assertions.assertion: Adds Duende.Storage.Sqlite NuGet package (or references it)
Calls AddUserManagement() on the IdentityServer builder with a configuration lambda
assertions.rationale: Calls `.AddUserManagement()` and shows the lambda form `.AddUserManagement(o => o.Authentication(a => a.UseSmtpOtpDispatcher(...)))` for email delivery.

assertions.assertion: Selects the SQLite provider with AddStorage(storage => storage.AddSqlite(...)) on the IdentityServer builder (not inside the AddUserManagement lambda)
assertions.rationale: Uses `.AddStorage(storage => storage.AddSqlite(o => o.ConnectionString = ...))` on the IdentityServer builder and explicitly warns against placing it in AddUserManagement.

assertions.assertion: Creates the database schema with IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync() resolved from IStorageInstanceSchemaFactory.GetStorageInstanceSchema(...)
assertions.rationale: Resolves IStorageInstanceSchemaFactory, calls GetStorageInstanceSchema(ct) then schema.MigrateAsync(ct).
